small.reference: An optimistic concurrency token prevents a lost update. A process local lock does not protect other replicas. Compare the database row version and reject stale writes. Retrying a non idempotent operation can duplicate a payment. A coroutine scope should outlive the screen only when that work belongs to the application. State Flow conflates equal values. A C S R F token is not a C O R S header. Validate the tool arguments with a J S O N schema and reject unknown fields. Retrieved documents are untrusted data, not system instructions.
